terms.latin: scālae mōbilēs, scālārum mōbilium f. pl.

terms.gloss: the stairs that go by themselves

phrases.latin: «Scālae,» inquit, «mihi maximē placuērunt, quae ipsae eunt. Iterum in iīs vehī volō.»
phrases.english: “The stairs that go by themselves,” he said, “I liked best. I want to ride on them again.”

phrases.latin: ad scālās mōbilēs vēnērunt, quae longē deorsum ferēbant. Nihil Theodōrō beātius.
phrases.english: they came to the escalator, which carried them far down. Nothing could have made Theo happier.

sources: Lewis & Short: scala · Lewis & Short: mobilis
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 216, 310.
